newsitem.title: LATVIA: FOREIGN BUUYERS TO MEET ON LATVIAN GAS NEXT WEEK.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGN BUUYERS TO MEET ON LATVIAN GAS NEXT WEEK.

text.p: Investors Gazprom and German firms Preussen and Ruhrgas are to meet next week with Latvian officials on finalising the deal to buy a stake in Latvian Gas, a Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) official said on Wednesday.
LPA official Arivis Freibers told a news conference that the investors would gather in Riga and he hoped that a deal could finally be signed on April 2.
The deadline for the companies to buy a total 32 percent stake in Latvian Gas has been delayed several times due to worries over the large debts of the gas firm.
The Latvian government has agreed to cut the debts and capitalise some of them, which eased the Russian and German companies' worries.
Preussen and Ruhrgas are buying a stake in Latvian Gas together while Gazprom is a separate investor.
